sv.title: Centerpartiet väljer Magdalena Anderssons totalpaket
sv.summary: Centerpartiet har valt Socialdemokraternas Magdalena Anderssons (S) totalpaket. Det meddelar partiledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist.

en.title: The Centre Party chooses Magdalena Andersson's total package
en.summary: The Centre Party has chosen the Social Democrats' Magdalena Andersson (S) total package. Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist announces this.
